mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk made the nerve and blood routes feel like connections across one body rather than separate pieces.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt to join the chest and lower body was frustrating: their matching edges made the pairing seem ready, but the required preparation was not clear beforehand.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the chest first needed the arm and lymph network fitted before it could join the lower body.

arbitrary.text: The order requiring those chest fittings before joining the regions felt somewhat arbitrary, even though their eventual locations made sense.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it explored how the assembled systems work together. Seeing the nerve and blood routes come together was more interesting than just filling named slots.
